items.title: Deploy and secure for production (AgentCore Runtime, guardrails, and sandboxes) | Learn Strands Agents with Kiro 08
items.summary: This Level 300 deck shows how to prepare a Strands Agents agent for production, with limits on turns, tool calls, tokens and time and a window on the conversation history, and how to deploy it to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and AWS Lambda, using the official docs and real output from strands-agents 1.64.0 in the Tokyo Region. It also covers securing tools, prompts and history (Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, shadow mode, trusted message history) and running tools inside a sandbox, as deck 08 (Ship and extend) of the series Learn Strands Agents with Kiro.
